verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only states general support for x86/ARM/PowerPC CPUs as a hardware target. Nothing documents using AVX, AVX2, AVX512 or AMX instruction sets to speed up inference. Generic x86 CPU support is related but is not the specific instruction-set acceleration this story asks for.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can leverage advanced x86 CPU instruction sets like AVX, AVX2, AVX512, and AMX for faster inference
